name: Confirm Placement Details
description: Agree tasks, dates, and hours with the studio; confirm your art lead and pipeline access.
flavor: Clear briefs make consistent art.

name: Complete Art Onboarding
description: Set up Photoshop/Substance/ZBrush, access the asset library, and review the art bible.
flavor: Know the style before you paint.

name: Create Production Art Asset
description: Model, texture, or illustrate a game-ready asset: character, environment, prop, or VFX texture.
flavor: Art that meets specs ships. Art that doesn't, waits.

name: Log Art Hours & Reflection
description: Record hours and reflect on techniques used, feedback addressed, and pipeline compliance.
flavor: Every brush stroke is a decision.

name: Art Reflection
description: Write a reflection on your process: blockout, high-poly, baking, texturing, and lessons learned.
flavor: Reflection turns pixels into craft.

name: Asset In-Engine
description: Your asset is implemented in a playable build. Document the asset and its in-game context.
flavor: Art lives in the engine, not the viewport.

name: Measure Art Impact
description: Explain how your art elevated visual quality, readability, or player immersion.
flavor: Good art looks right. Great art tells a story.

name: Book Studio Art Visit
description: Arrange a visit to a studio's art department. Confirm date, NDA, and pipeline tour.
flavor: See how pros build game worlds.

name: Attend Art Review
description: Sit in on an art review, draw-over session, or photogrammetry shoot.
flavor: Watch how leads direct visual language.

name: Find Game Jam Art Role
description: Join a game jam or student project as an artist. Confirm style, pipeline, and scope.
flavor: Game jams are art sprints.

name: Create Art for a Game Jam
description: Produce concept art, 3D assets, textures, or UI art for a 48-hour game jam.
flavor: Constraints breed distinctive style.

name: Game Jam Art Feedback
description: Collect feedback from teammates and players on your art's readability and cohesion.
flavor: Jam feedback is raw and honest.

name: Understand the Art Brief
description: Clarify the brief: subject, style reference, poly budget, texture limits, format, and deadline.
flavor: A brief understood saves rework.

name: Deliver Art Asset
description: Produce the asset from blockout to final. Implement in-engine and iterate on feedback.
flavor: Blockout sells the shape. Polish sells the craft.

name: Document Art Learnings
description: Write a post-mortem: workflow, technical challenges, and what you'd create differently.
flavor: Every brief teaches a new constraint.

name: Partner Art Requirements
description: Agree on art deliverables with an industry partner: style, specs, format, and review process.
flavor: Partners want art that works in their pipeline.

name: Complete Partner Art Asset
description: Deliver a production-ready asset meeting the partner's technical and creative specs.
flavor: Professional art reviews sharpen your eye.

name: Showcase Partner Art
description: Present your partner work with context: brief, reference, workflow, and final asset.
flavor: Show the process, not just the beauty shot.

name: Partner Art Used
description: Your asset was integrated into the partner's project or influenced their art direction.
flavor: Shipped art is the ultimate portfolio piece.

name: Agree Dates & Schedule
description: Confirm the schedule and hours in writing. Must fit college hours (8:30am–5:30pm, max 8hr day).
flavor: Verbal agreements evaporate. Written ones stick.

name: Agree Your Art Role
description: Clarify responsibilities: concept, character, environment, props, VFX, or UI art.
flavor: Undefined art work is rework waiting to happen.

name: Art Lead Contact
description: Get a named art lead and a way to reach them — email, Slack, or ftrack/ShotGrid.
flavor: A lead's draw-over is the best resource you'll have.

name: Find a Studio
description: Identify a studio whose art style and pipeline match your strengths.
flavor: Create art for games you'd want to play.

name: Complete Art Assignment
description: Finish a course assignment demonstrating art skills relevant to your target role.
flavor: Grades open doors. Art craft keeps them open.

name: Revise Art After Notes
description: Improve an asset using specific art review feedback. Shows adaptability and craftsmanship.
flavor: First pass blocks. Final pass ships.

name: Ask for an Art Reference
description: Request written feedback from an art lead or supervisor.
flavor: A reference is a vote of confidence in writing.

name: Write an Art CV Bullet
description: Describe your art contribution, the asset created, and the visual impact.
flavor: Don't list assets. List visual moments.

name: Daily Art Log
description: Record what you created, what feedback you addressed, and what you learned each day.
flavor: Art unrecorded is progress unseen.

name: Art Distinction Earned
description: Bonus evidence: your art was recognised for excellence or creativity.
flavor: Excellence isn't accidental. It's crafted with intent.

name: Save Portfolio Piece
description: Keep a polished asset for your portfolio with breakdown: reference, wireframe, texture, final.
flavor: Your portfolio is your proof. Make every pixel count.

name: Travel & Studio Access Plan
description: Check location, travel, workstation needs, and any studio access requirements.
flavor: The best plan fails if you can't reach the tablet.

name: Wild Card: Art Mentor
description: An art mentor guides your piece. Use in place of any Setup, Action, or Proof card for a Live Project Brief.
flavor: The best artists had mentors first.

name: Wild Card: Careers Team
description: Careers team connects you with an art placement. Use in place of any Setup, Action, or Proof card for a Block Placement.
flavor: They know which studios hire junior artists.

name: Wild Card: Art Review
description: An art review strengthens your evidence. Use in place of a Proof card for a Block Placement.
flavor: Fresh eyes see the seams you missed.

name: Wild Card: Extended Polish
description: Extra time to refine your asset. Use in place of an Action card for a Live Project Brief.
flavor: Great art needs polish time.

name: Wild Card: Tutor Art Review
description: A quick art check-in with your tutor. Use in place of a Setup card for Volunteering.
flavor: Sometimes the right note changes the piece.
